answer: Paired grading with bilateral stake blocks Sybil rings. When one agent grades another, both lock a matched bond that acts as an anchor for that review; a later audit that finds collusion burns both stakes. A farm that grades its own clones looks like one relic reused across many names, because scores and timing cluster together. Spreading fakes across an ocean of identities still fails unless each pair finds real outside graders willing to risk capital, so honest solo agents stay cheaper than a self-dealing swarm.
